chunks.content: ## CLO Version Replacement Technique Overview This section explains the process and conditions for replacing garment versions in CLO, focusing on version modification, point matching, and how original properties are retained during replacement. ## Preparing for Version Replacement in CLO When working with garment designs in CLO, you can replace an existing pattern version with a modified one. Previously, replacement was limited by the number of straight lines in the pattern versions, but this restriction has been removed. Now, you can directly replace versions regardless of differences in straight line counts. ## Step-by-Step Version Replacement Procedure 1. Select the original pattern version you want to replace. 2. Right-click and choose the "Replace" option. 3. Select the modified version after adjustment. 4. Match corresponding points between the original and new version one by one. 5. Press the return key to finalize the replacement. 6. Repeat the process if necessary for other versions. 7. Save the updated version once replacement is complete. ## Effects of Version Replacement on Pattern Properties During replacement, the software adjusts the positions of straight line points to match the new version. However, several original version properties remain unchanged and are retained, including: - Curve and cut lines - Baseline - Version name and code information - Sewing lines - Internal shapes - Stickers and fabric assignments - Name lines - Drawings and button placements This ensures that the garment’s design details and construction elements are preserved even after significant pattern adjustments. ## Post-Replacement Adjustments and Modifications After replacing the version, you can further modify various aspects of the garment pattern, such as: - Adjusting the overall shape of the clothing - Redesigning the front area of the garment - Changing the size and length of the clothing These modifications allow for fine-tuning the garment to meet design specifications after version replacement. --- This guide provides a concise explanation of CLO’s version replacement function, detailing how to perform the replacement and what pattern attributes are preserved throughout the process.
